claim.claim-text: 2. The computer-implemented method of claim 1, wherein the action includes hard-braking.
3. The computer-implemented method of claim 2, wherein hard-braking causes deceleration of the vehicle by at least 4.4 meters per second squared.

4. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein determining that the pedestrian is far from a crosswalk comprises determining that traffic is moving at a fast speed in the direction of the vehicle when the pedestrian can be discerned in the camera.

5. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein determining that the pedestrian is far from a crosswalk comprises detecting an intersection crossing at a first time, detecting the pedestrian at a second time, and determining a distance travelled by the vehicle between the first time and the second time based on a speed of the vehicle between the first time and the second time.

6. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein assessing a risk of a collision event between the vehicle and the pedestrian comprises determining a future path of travel of the vehicle and determining an interaction between the future path of travel and the pedestrian.

7. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, wherein determining whether a driver of the vehicle performs an action that is responsive to the pedestrian crossing the road far from a crosswalk comprises sensing, using an inertial sensor coupled to the vehicle, a braking event.

8. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, comprising comparing the risk of a driving environment after the driver of the first vehicle performed the action with a risk assessment of a driving environment before the driver performed the action.

9. The computer-implemented method of any preceding claim, comprising transmitting data to a remote device, wherein the data includes an inference that the driver performed the action that mitigated risk.
10. The computer-implemented method of claim 9, wherein the data includes video data from the camera (102).
11. The computer-implemented method of claim 10, comprising training an autonomous vehicle driving system with the video data.
a memory (114); and a processor (110) coupled to the memory (114), wherein the processor (110) is configured to perform the steps of the method of any one of claims 1 to 11.
13. A computer-readable storage medium comprising instructions which, when executed by a computer, cause the computer to carry out the steps of the method of any one of claims 1 to 11.
